env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^mixed selects local$'
stdout '^mixed bothkeys ambiguous$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/mixed

go 1.27

-- w/a/a.lgo --
package a

type Circle struct {
  R int64 `json:"r"`
}

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
  "encoding/json"
  "fmt"

  "example.com/mixed/a"
)

type Local struct {
  S int64 `json:"s"`
}

type MixedUnion interface {
  Local | a.Circle
}

type MixedHolder struct {
  Item MixedUnion `json:"item"`
}

func main() {
  var m MixedHolder
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"s":9}}`), &m); err != nil {
    panic("mixed unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  if l, ok := m.Item.(Local); !ok || l.S != 9 {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("mixed want Local S=9 got %T %#v", m.Item, m.Item))
  }
  fmt.Println("mixed selects local")
  var mb MixedHolder
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"r":1,"s":2}}`), &mb); err == nil {
    panic("mixed bothkeys want error got nil")
  }
  fmt.Println("mixed bothkeys ambiguous")
}
